aiSupport.privacy: Agents use Claude Team, never Pro, so customer messages are not trained on.

labour.note: Hours a month = fixed + variable x paying seats / 1,000, with the AI factor on support minutes. Ceiling = paying seats where hours reach 160 a month. The low contact-rate row is primary and the median the stress case. Variable labour per paying seat is $0.33 (low) and $1.43 (median) at the loaded $53.80 support rate.

payerModes.description: The steward is billed for every seat and holds the R5 discount for seats in other covens.
Every member subscribes to their own seat at the same seat prices; R5 does not apply; a member who stops paying keeps a read-only seat until they pay again.

payerModes.note: Revenue per coven is held equal in both modes because no source says which converts better. Member-pays pays Stripe's 30c fixed fee per member, about $0.23 more per paying seat a month (derived), which the tables leave out. Switching takes effect at the next renewal. Wave 21 entitlement paths, webhook cases and stories roughly double.

models.name: (b) Each user pays
models.description: Each person pays once and it unlocks every coven they belong to.

priceTable.example: One subscription unlocks every coven the person belongs to.

models.example: A coven of 5 where one member already pays elsewhere brings in 4 payments of $4.00, so $16.00 a month, because the fifth person is already paying.
models.reception: Obsidian does it, but few people share the cost of one account.

models.name: (c) Base plus seats
models.description: The steward pays a base for a minimum group and each extra member adds a seat.

priceTable.example: A coven of 3 practitioners pays only the base.
The 4th and 5th practitioners each add a seat.
A viewer costs half a practitioner seat; observers are not counted in the base.

priceTable.level: Discounted seat (the member pays for a coven of their own elsewhere)
priceTable.price: 50% off the seat: $1.00 for a practitioner seat, $0.50 for an observer seat
priceTable.example: Only a paying steward of another coven gets it.

models.example: A coven of 5 has 4 practitioners and 1 observer, and one of the practitioners pays for a coven of their own elsewhere. It pays the $6.00 base for 3 practitioners, $1.00 for the fourth practitioner (a $2.00 seat at half price because that member pays for a coven elsewhere) and $1.00 for the observer, so $8.00 a month. Without a member paying elsewhere it would be $9.00.
models.reception: Meets every want, though per-seat pricing draws complaints.

models.name: (g) Group plan includes a solo coven (over (c))
models.description: Every paid seat in a group coven also gives that member a free solo coven; a person with no paid group seat buys a solo coven alone. Modelled over (c).
models.pricePoints: $2.31 revenue per paying seat: (c) for group seats, a $2.99 solo coven alone for 20% of paying seats, and $1.99 solo add-ons from 20% of observers (assumptions)

priceTable.price: Same as (c): $6 base for 3 practitioners, $2 each extra practitioner, $1 each observer, half off a seat held by a paying steward of another coven
$2.99 a month (proposed; $1.99 or $4.99 are the alternatives)
priceTable.example: A person with no paid group seat buys one.

priceTable.level: Solo coven added by an observer
priceTable.price: Solo price less $1: $1.99 a month at the modelled $2.99 ($0.99 or $3.99 if $1.99 or $4.99 is chosen)
priceTable.example: An observer pays the difference on their own subscription, not the coven's invoice; modelled take-up is 20% of observers (assumption).

priceTable.level: Solo coven with a paid practitioner or steward seat
priceTable.example: Every paid practitioner or steward seat includes one; an observer seat does not.

models.example: A coven of 5 pays $8.00 as in (c) ($6 base + $1 discounted practitioner seat + $1 observer; one member pays for a coven of their own elsewhere), and the 4 practitioners each also get a free solo coven; the observer does not, but could add one for $1.99 a month on their own subscription.

requirements.R5: kept: a member's solo coven is free

models.reception: Solo journal apps charge $1.99 to $4.99 a month, but no comparable bundles a free one into a group plan, and the free covens cost little to host.

models.name: (h) Flat seats, $3 / $1 (illustrative)
models.description: No base fee. A practitioner seat includes a solo coven; an observer seat costs less and becomes a practitioner seat by paying the difference; a solo coven alone costs the same as a practitioner seat; a paying steward gets 50% off practitioner seats in other covens.
models.pricePoints: $3.00 practitioner / $1.00 observer; $2.98 revenue per paying seat (illustrative)

priceTable.example: Includes a solo coven of the member's own.
The observer becomes a practitioner seat and gets a solo coven; modelled take-up 20% (assumption).
Costs the same as a practitioner seat.

models.example: A coven of 5: 3 practitioners and 2 observers, one practitioner also pays for a coven elsewhere. At $3 / $1 the bill is 2 x $3 + $1.50 + 2 x $1 = $9.50; if one observer upgrades it is $11.50.

requirements.R1: kept (the steward's bill is seats x price)
requirements.R5: kept: 50% off for paying stewards; every practitioner seat has a free solo coven

models.reception: Per-seat pricing with a cheaper view-only seat is common (Figma Collab $3 beside a $16 full seat); solo coven anchors are Bear $2.99, Neumoire $1.99 and Grimoire $4.99, as in (g). No comparable gives a paying steward 50% off.

models.name: (h) Flat seats, $2.27 / $1 (calibrated to (g))
models.description: No base fee. A practitioner seat includes a solo coven; an observer seat costs less and becomes a practitioner seat by paying the difference; a solo coven alone costs the same as a practitioner seat; a paying steward gets 50% off practitioner seats in other covens.
models.pricePoints: $2.27 practitioner / $1.00 observer, calibrated so a paying seat brings $2.31 as in (g): p = ($2.3149 - $0.2304) / 0.9173 = $2.2722. Matching (c) per group coven instead gives $1.94.

priceTable.example: Includes a solo coven of the member's own.
The observer becomes a practitioner seat and gets a solo coven; modelled take-up 20% (assumption).
Costs the same as a practitioner seat.

models.example: The same coven at $2.27 / $1: 2 x $2.27 + $1.135 + 2 x $1 = $7.68; with one observer upgrade (+$1.27) it is $8.95.

requirements.R1: kept (the steward's bill is seats x price)
requirements.R5: kept: 50% off for paying stewards; every practitioner seat has a free solo coven

models.reception: Per-seat pricing with a cheaper view-only seat is common (Figma Collab $3 beside a $16 full seat); solo coven anchors are Bear $2.99, Neumoire $1.99 and Grimoire $4.99, as in (g). No comparable gives a paying steward 50% off.

processors.name: Stripe Billing + Tax, hosted Checkout
processors.fees: About 11.6% of a $10 seat by API (2.9% + 30c, 0.7% Billing, 0.5% Tax Basic); 7.1% no-code
processors.merchantOfRecord: No. The site is the merchant and files its own tax.
processors.contentPolicyRisk: Lowest: its list names only psychic services, in three countries
processors.serverSideOnly: Yes, hosted Checkout loads no Stripe.js on the site
processors.officialMock: Yes, stripe-mock, but it keeps no state and sends no webhooks

processors.name: Stripe Managed Payments

processors.contentPolicyRisk: Same list as Stripe, plus an eligibility review

processors.recommendation: Fallback if you do not want to file sales tax.

options.option: $1 against $2 for a practitioner, 30% observers - the ones modelled
